fields.note: The core rule, add-on changes, LAHD-approval programs, market-rate triggers, the 2020-2024 prohibition, the $1.61 registration surcharge and the $3.00 detector surcharge are all in the document. The 3% rate for 7/1/2025-6/30/2026, the $2.83 SCEP figure and the state-law 30-day notice for increases under 10% do not appear. The document gives the SCEP charge only as 1/12 of 50% of the annual fee, and the allowable-percentage PDF is not captured.

fields.quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage
fields.note: The once-per-12-months rule, the end of the utility and dependent add-ons, the 10% non-dependent tenant add-on within 60 days, and the $1.61 and $3.00 surcharges are supported. The 3% rate and the SCEP $2.83/mo figure are not in the document.

fields.quoted_span: Effective February 2, 2026, the landlord can no longer include an additional percentage increase for utilities.
fields.note: The document gives 2026-02-02 as the date the utility and dependent add-ons ended.

fields.quoted_span: Generally, the RSO applies to rental properties that were first built on or before October 1, 1978
fields.note: The cutoff, replacement units under LAMC 151.28, covered unit types, the condo/townhome 12/31/1995 carve-out, the luxury exemption and temporary exemptions are all supported. The summary's statement that RSO units are excluded from the state AB 1482 cap, and the supersedes_state_rule flag, are not in this document.
The document never cites L.A. Mun. Code § 151.06. It cites only LAMC Section 151.28 and 151.09.C.9, plus RAC regulations.
